statement: Repair the currently admitted PostgreSQL extended-query description contract through the existing pgwire adapter and compatibility matrix: statement/portal Describe reports correct parameter and result metadata without executing effects, Bind and DataRow agree with that metadata including empty and NULL-valued results, and unsupported protocol or isolation behavior is explicitly refused. Consume the normative 0.4.1 continuation in solve/specs/pilot-readiness-and-public-proof/requirements.md without adding a second SQL engine or changing the sealed Q10 verdict.

constraints.statement: Initial completion is 0.4.1 because admitted extended-query behavior must be truthful. Preserve the sealed terminal postgres-compatibility-certification-matrix record and all supported cells. Optional SELECT service-call aliases, cluster-routed CancelRequest and new isolation/consistency capabilities remain separate 0.5 decisions.

Use src/runtime/pgwire-extended-query-handler.js, src/query/pg/postgres-wire-adapter.js and the existing compatibility catalog/matrix. Metadata discovery cannot execute guest code or effects. Unknown formats, isolation or suspension behavior must follow declared typed refusal; a silent no-op or deleting a supported matrix cell cannot close the Quest.

This Quest does not introduce a SELECT call alias. Any separately admitted alias must normalize into canonical BINDING_CALL authorization and invocation/effect ownership before execution, with a stable JSON result or a fixed descriptor-pinned schema; the ordinary EXECUTE_QUERY classifier cannot authorize it implicitly.

This registration is unsealed and contains source observations only. Preregister named external-driver versions, wire packets, result/parameter descriptors, SQLSTATEs and adverse schedules, then obtain an actual production-adapter red witness before sealing. Exact-candidate live driver receipts, red-on-removal checks and independent verification are required; a script-symbol check or missing receipt is not proof.
